title: fix: unblock dashboard loading from billing and earnings
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes Stripe billing from the shared dashboard loader; only the Pollen page fetches it. Previously every signed-in dashboard page waited for Stripe before rendering.
- Lets weekly earnings load after the dashboard renders using the router's existing `Await`. Wallet balances remain visible while earnings are pending or unavailable.
- Shows a loading message while Pollen waits for billing. Keeps the change to two route files, with no new dependencies or caching logic.
- Addresses #14000. The reported long delay was not reproduced; this removes confirmed blocking dependencies, without assuming catalog size caused the incident.
- Validation: production frontend build, TypeScript, and Biome pass. Actual loader, router, and rendering checks cover deferred/failed earnings, signed-out loading, Pollen-only billing and its pending state, and pack navigation preserving billing data.

gist.headline: Dashboard leaves the loading dock
gist.blurb: The dashboard no longer holds every page hostage while Stripe clears its throat. Billing now stays on the Pollen page, and weekly earnings can arrive fashionably late.
gist.summary: Removed Stripe billing from the shared dashboard loader so only the Pollen route fetches it, while weekly earnings now render through deferred Await loading without hiding wallet balances.
gist.impact: Signed-in dashboard pages can render without waiting for billing, and users keep seeing wallet balances while weekly earnings load or are temporarily unavailable.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy dashboard garden where Polli helps a retro terminal display a visible wallet balance immediately, while a small Pollen-only billing kiosk calmly loads in the background. Show weekly earnings arriving later as a little envelope carried along a vine, making the distinction between instant dashboard access and deferred data clear.
